We accept the following payment methods: Frequently asked questions Can I share the same Octo Browser account with a colleague? Yes. You can easily use 2-3 devices at the same time. How can I change my subscription? You can upgrade your subscription at any time. Downgrading to a lower-tier subscription is only possible after your current subscription expires. To do so, you need to top up your account balance and select the desired subscription. Please note that you will have to remove any resources exceeding the limits of the new subscription when downgrading. How else can I increase the number of available profiles? You can purchase additional profiles based on your subscription: Starter: 20 additional profiles; Base: 100 additional profiles; Team: 250 additional profiles; Advanced: 98,800 additional profiles. How can I increase the number of available team members? You can upgrade to a higher-tier subscription that offers more team member slots. If you have a Team subscription, you can expand your team to 6 members. You can add unlimited team members with the Advanced subscription. I need to increase the number of available API requests. What should I do? You can switch to a subscription that allows more API requests. You can increase your API limits to 1,000 requests per minute (RPM) and 50,000 requests per hour (RPH) with the Advanced subscription. How can I get a Custom subscription with more profiles? Simply get in touch with our Customer Service and our experts will gladly help you create your own Custom subscription.
